nodes.name: Every 15 Minutes
nodes.notes: System Warden health check: runs every 60 minutes to monitor all LNL workflows

nodes.name: Get Recent Executions
nodes.notes: Fetches last 50 executions from n8n API (reduced from 200 to avoid rate limits). REQUIRES n8nApi credentials.

nodes.name: Analyze System Health
nodes.notes: Analyzes executions against workflow registry. Checks for errors and stale heartbeats. v2: 6-hour cooldown suppresses repeat alerts for the same issue.

nodes.name: IF Issues Found
nodes.notes: Routes to alert path if any issues detected, otherwise logs all-clear

nodes.name: Format Health Alert
nodes.notes: Formats email subject/body and Sheet Hygiene Log fields for health alerts

nodes.name: Send Health Alert
nodes.notes: Sends health alert email via SMTP. Configure ALERT_EMAIL env var or edit toEmail directly.

nodes.name: Log Health Alert
nodes.notes: Logs health alert to Sheet Hygiene Log in Master Brain

nodes.name: Prepare All Clear
nodes.notes: Formats all-clear log entry when no issues detected

nodes.name: Log All Clear
nodes.notes: Logs all-clear status to Sheet Hygiene Log

nodes.name: Error Trigger
nodes.notes: Catches real-time errors from any workflow that has this workflow set as its Error Workflow. Configure other workflows: Settings > Error Workflow > select this workflow.

nodes.name: Format Error Details
nodes.notes: Formats real-time error data for email alert and Sheet Hygiene Log

nodes.name: Send Error Alert
nodes.notes: Sends immediate error alert email

nodes.name: Log Error
nodes.notes: Logs error details to Sheet Hygiene Log
